nodes.description: Public address state variable holding the contract owner; assigned msg.sender in constructor and updated in acceptOwnership.
Public address state variable holding the pending owner during two-step ownership transfer.
Public token symbol string, set to MIA in the constructor.
Public token name string, set to MIAMIcoin in the constructor.
Public token decimals value, set to 18 in the constructor.
Public total token supply, set in constructor and read by totalSupply().
Mapping of account address to token balance; mutated by transfer and transferFrom via SafeMath helpers.
Nested mapping owner=>spender=>amount representing ERC20 allowances.
Pure helper that adds two uint values and requires the result to be >= a to prevent overflow.
Pure helper that subtracts b from a after requiring b <= a to prevent underflow.
Pure helper that multiplies two uint values and validates the result via division.
Pure helper that divides a by b after requiring b > 0.
Constructor of Owned that initializes owner with msg.sender.
onlyOwner function that stages a new owner in newOwner.
Function that lets the pending newOwner claim ownership, requiring msg.sender == newOwner.
Token constructor that sets metadata, mints the full supply to a fixed address and emits Transfer.
Constant function returning _totalSupply minus balances[address(0)].
Constant function returning the balance of tokenOwner.
ERC20 transfer that subtracts tokens from msg.sender and adds them to the recipient using SafeMath.
ERC20 approve that sets allowed[msg.sender][spender] and emits Approval.
ERC20 transferFrom that debits the from balance, reduces the caller allowance and credits the destination.
Constant function returning the remaining allowance of a spender for a token owner.
Sets an allowance and then invokes receiveApproval on the spender contract with an external call.
Payable fallback function that unconditionally reverts, rejecting plain ETH transfers.
onlyOwner function that performs an arbitrary external ERC20 transfer(address,uint) call sending tokens to owner.
Interface hook implemented by spender contracts and invoked by approveAndCall.
Caller-controlled address used for ownership checks, balance debits and allowance bookkeeping.
Unsigned addition c = a + b in safeAdd; overflow prevented only by the subsequent require.
Unsigned subtraction c = a - b in safeSub; underflow prevented only by require(b <= a).
Unsigned multiplication c = a * b in safeMul with a division-based overflow check.
External call to an arbitrary user-supplied spender contract executing receiveApproval with attacker-controlled data.
External call to an arbitrary tokenAddress contract's transfer(address,uint) selected by the owner.

Address parameter staged as the pending new owner.
Address parameter whose balance is looked up.

Address granted the allowance in approve.

Token owner address queried in allowance.

Return variable holding the remaining allowance.

edges.reason: Owned constructor assigns the caller-controlled msg.sender to the owner state variable.
onlyOwner modifier requires msg.sender == owner before transferOwnership executes.
acceptOwnership requires msg.sender == newOwner to claim ownership.
transferAnyERC20Token is guarded by the onlyOwner modifier using msg.sender.
transfer reads and writes balances[msg.sender] as the debited account.
approve writes allowed[msg.sender][spender] using the caller address.
transferFrom decrements allowed[from][msg.sender] using the caller as spender.
approveAndCall forwards msg.sender into the external receiveApproval callback.
transferOwnership writes the supplied address into newOwner.
acceptOwnership copies newOwner into owner, completing the ownership handover.
Constructor initializes the symbol state variable.
Constructor initializes the name state variable.
Constructor initializes the decimals state variable.
Constructor writes the fixed total supply.
Constructor mints the whole supply into balances of the fixed holder address.
totalSupply reads the _totalSupply state variable.
totalSupply subtracts balances[address(0)] from the stored supply.
balanceOf reads the balances mapping for the requested account.
transfer updates the balances mapping for sender and recipient.
transfer calls safeAdd to credit the recipient.
transfer calls safeSub to debit the sender.
approve writes the allowance into the allowed mapping.
transferFrom debits and credits entries of the balances mapping.
transferFrom decreases the spender allowance stored in allowed.
transferFrom uses safeAdd for the recipient credit.
transferFrom uses safeSub for balance and allowance debits.
allowance reads the nested allowed mapping.
approveAndCall writes the allowance into the allowed mapping before the callback.
approveAndCall executes an external call to the spender-controlled contract.
The external call invokes receiveApproval on the attacker-supplied spender contract, allowing reentrant execution.
transferAnyERC20Token performs an external call into a caller-chosen token contract.
The chosen token contract can re-enter the token contract during the external transfer.
safeAdd performs an unchecked unsigned addition whose safety relies on the following require.
safeSub performs an unsigned subtraction guarded only by require(b <= a).
safeMul performs an unsigned multiplication validated by a division check.
transferAnyERC20Token sends the recovered tokens to the owner address, reading owner state.
Parameter a feeds the addition inside safeAdd.
Parameter b feeds the addition inside safeAdd.
safeAdd writes the result into the local return variable c.
Parameter a feeds the subtraction inside safeSub.
Parameter b feeds the subtraction inside safeSub.
safeSub writes the result into the local return variable c.
Parameter a feeds the multiplication inside safeMul.
Parameter b feeds the multiplication inside safeMul.
safeMul writes the result into the local return variable c.
Parameter a is the dividend used inside safeDiv.
Parameter b is the divisor used inside safeDiv.
safeDiv writes the quotient into the local return variable c.
Parameter _newOwner is stored into the newOwner state variable.
Parameter tokenOwner indexes the balances mapping read by balanceOf.
Parameter to is the credited account in transfer.
Parameter tokens is the amount moved by transfer.
transfer sets its local success return flag to true.
Parameter spender indexes the allowance written by approve.
Parameter tokens is the allowance amount written by approve.
approve sets its local success return flag to true.
Parameter from identifies the debited account in transferFrom.
Parameter to identifies the credited account in transferFrom.
Parameter tokens is the amount moved and deducted from the allowance.
transferFrom sets its local success return flag to true.
Parameter tokenOwner indexes the outer key of the allowed mapping read by allowance.
Parameter spender indexes the inner key of the allowed mapping read by allowance.
allowance writes the looked-up value into the local remaining variable.
Parameter spender is both the allowance grantee and the external contract invoked.
Parameter tokens sets the allowance and is forwarded to the callback.
Parameter data is attacker-controlled calldata forwarded into the external callback call.
approveAndCall sets its local success return flag to true.
Parameter tokenAddress selects the arbitrary external contract that is called.
Parameter tokens is the amount forwarded in the rescue transfer.
transferAnyERC20Token stores the external call result in its local success variable.

normalization_plan.reason: Parameter a only exists to feed the additive operation inside safeAdd and carries no independent semantics.
Parameter b only exists to feed the additive operation inside safeAdd.
Local return variable c receives the arithmetic result produced by safeAdd.
Parameter a is the minuend consumed directly by the subtraction inside safeSub.
Parameter b is the subtrahend consumed directly by the subtraction inside safeSub.
Local return variable c receives the subtraction result produced by safeSub.
Parameter a is a factor only used by the multiplication in safeMul.
Parameter b is a factor only used by the multiplication in safeMul.
Local return variable c receives the multiplication result produced by safeMul.
Parameter a is the dividend consumed only by the division in safeDiv.
Parameter b is the divisor validated and divided by safeDiv.
Local return variable c receives the quotient produced by safeDiv.
Parameter _newOwner is immediately stored into the newOwner state variable by transferOwnership.
Parameter tokenOwner is only an index into the balances mapping read by balanceOf.
Parameter to is only the credited account of the transfer function.
Parameter tokens is only the amount consumed by the balance updates in transfer.
Local success flag is a constant true return value with no independent meaning.
Parameter spender is only the inner key written into the allowed mapping by approve.
Parameter tokens is only the allowance value written by approve.
Local success flag is a constant true return value of approve.
Parameter from is only the debited address in transferFrom.
Parameter to is only the credited address in transferFrom.
Parameter tokens is only the moved amount in transferFrom.
Local success flag is a constant true return value of transferFrom.
Parameter tokenOwner is only an index into the allowed mapping read by allowance.
Parameter spender is only the second index into the allowed mapping read by allowance.
Local remaining variable simply holds the mapping lookup returned by allowance.
Parameter spender is used both as allowance key and as the target of the external callback in approveAndCall.
Parameter tokens is only the allowance value and callback argument in approveAndCall.
Parameter data is attacker-controlled payload passed straight into the external receiveApproval call.
Local success flag is a constant true return value of approveAndCall.
Parameter tokenAddress selects the arbitrary contract targeted by the external transfer call.
Parameter tokens is only the amount forwarded in the external rescue call.
Local success variable only carries the external call result returned by the function.
